Partner Reported Opportunities (PRO) Fact Sheets (series of 22 used here: Nos. 101-106, 201-203, 205-207, 301, 401, 701, 702, 901-904, 908) and the 2014 PRO fact sheet Wet Seal Degassing Recovery System for Centrifugal Compressors. Washington, DC: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. Retrieved from the 19 January 2017 snapshot of epa.gov, 2026-10-02.

One extraction for the series; each row's reference starts with the PDF file stem, then the page. Each fact sheet has a methane savings line and an economic evaluation table at $7/$5/$3 per Mcf. Loaded: description, state-of-development, capex per installation, opex-fixed, capacity where printed. Gas saved and paybacks in _measures (not loaded); emission rates and partner figures in _other-values. No price year is printed except PRO 104 (2010) and the 2014 wet-seal sheet ($2011); 2011, the revision year, is assumed elsewhere and flagged PRICE YEAR ASSUMED. Full per-document notes and source defects in epa_2011_pro-fact-sheets_natural-gas-star_notes.md.

PRO 904 table capex 21,000 vs text 3,000 (both recorded, SOURCE INCONSISTENT); PRO 902 annual opex 10,000 treated as one-off in its paybacks; PRO 207, 205, 201 paybacks put one year of operating cost into the capital; PRO 702 O&M formula omits the hp-to-kW factor and 225 Mcf/d is printed as 675 MMcf/yr; PRO 903 headline saving 1.68 Mcf vs 652 Mcf valued; PRO 206 headline savings contradict its table; boxes convert methane to whole gas at 94% even for production gas (their own figure is 79%).
